metadata.case_name: CHENG MUK PING v. CHAN'S MACHINE ENGINEERING CO LTD

plaintiff.occupation_before: to service the Respondent’s machines hired out at various construction sites
plaintiff.occupation_after: worked at recycling companies and as a gardener; also worked as a driver and casual labourer in recycling companies

injuries.description: Lisfranc fracture on his right foot second metatarsal.
source: The Plaintiff sustained a Lisfranc fracture on his right foot second metatarsal.

manifestations.description: continuous pain in the right foot when he began walking or pushing the pedal with his foot
could no longer run or squat down
walked into the doctor’s clinic in a normal gait, he was able to walk on his heels but not on tiptoe, he could only stand on his left leg, and he could only do - of a normal squat.
weakness on his right leg due to the accident

treatments_received: operation of open reduction and internal fixation
foot put in a cast for 6 weeks
discharged with a pair of crutches
removal of all the screws inserted (admitted 29/1/05)

losses.category: Loss of ability to engage in sports and hobbies
losses.description: the injury and disabilities had prevented him from taking part in sports that he used to enjoy such as swimming, jogging, social dancing and mountaineering.
continuous pain and right ankle stiffness causing difficulty walking up and downstairs; could no longer run or squat down; weakness on right leg and limitation of movements of his right ankle.
